title: Oven BBQ {p} with {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Pull off the thin membrane on the back of the {p}. Rub all over with the {spice}, salt and pepper.

Seal the {p} tightly in foil with a splash of vinegar. Bake 2 1/2 to 3 hours, until very tender and the meat pulls back from the bone ends. It is safe once {doneness}, and ribs are well past that by the time they are tender.
About 45 minutes before the end, start the sides. {starch_how} {veg_how}
Open the foil and brush the {p} with the {sauce}. Broil 3 to 5 minutes until the glaze bubbles. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.
tip: Ribs are a treat. Serve a smaller portion with a big pile of slaw or green vegetables.
